notes:
An archive page that lists almost nothing is no longer told to delete itself.

`content.very_thin` reported a publisher's author pages at HIGH with the remedy
"write real content, merge it into a stronger related page, or remove it and
redirect". All three are wrong for an author archive: you do not write copy on
one, you cannot merge two authors, and deleting it breaks the byline link on
every article that author wrote.

The finding is kept — those pages really are near-empty — but moves to
`content.empty_archive` at LOW, with advice that refuses deletion and offers
`noindex, follow` instead.

Thin pages that are genuinely thin writing are unaffected and still reported.
